source: CBS league stats page, 2025 season, RPB scoring — screenshotted by Angelo 2026-08-07
note: ACTUAL fantasy points scored in this league. Preseason projections compress the field toward the mean; these do not. Use them as the talent prior and let projections adjust only for personnel change.
validation: Recomputing these stat lines under RPB's scoring rules reproduces the actual FPTS to a mean absolute error of 13.2 on a 240-306 range (~5%). The residual is because points-allowed tiers apply PER GAME and we only have season totals — a defense that alternates shutouts and blowouts scores differently from one that allows the same total evenly.
